explanation: I found no Mathlib counterpart. This is a simp lemma that computes the component of the inverse counit isomorphism of `leftDegreeZeroEquivalence`, an equivalence defined in the TauCeti library itself. The statement uses other library definitions too (`degreeZeroIso`, `degreeZero`, `forgetToRightModuleCat`, `IsConcentratedInDegreeZero`). The proof only unfolds these definitions and then uses general category lemmas (`Equivalence.trans_counitIso`, `Category.id_comp`, `ObjectProperty.isoMk_inv`) before closing with `rfl`. So the content lies entirely in the library's own definitions. Mathlib has no DG modules or DG algebras of this kind, so no Mathlib declaration could state this result. I did not search Mathlib for it, because the statement depends on these library-specific definitions.
